title: Indian Councils Act 1892
definition: An enactment of the British Parliament that made incremental changes to the composition and functions of the legislative councils in British India, introducing the principle of indirect election and the right to discuss the annual budget and pose questions to the executive.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC Civil Services Prelims (evolution of legislative devolution, representative elements) and Mains GS-1/GS-2 (Constitutional Development, nationalist movement pressure on colonial administration).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Indian Councils Act 1892.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Early Nationalist Demands for Legislative Reform
